title: CodeWhale shell classification, task defaults and automation defaults bypass approvals
summary: Shell commands using execution-capable search flags can be classified as read-only and auto-approved. Separately, omitted automation auto_approve defaults to true and creates recurring tasks with bypassed approvals. An earlier task_create flaw in DeepSeek TUI, now CodeWhale, gave durable sub-agents shell access and automatic approval by default; that task-path flaw was fixed in 0.8.26.

severity.rationale: Agent-supplied arguments can cross the advertised approval boundary and execute commands silently. Automation can preserve that capability in recurring runs. The vendor rates the earlier task_create flaw Critical, but it requires user approval of task creation, a meaningful precondition supporting high under this rubric; that task-path flaw is fixed in deepseek-tui 0.8.26.

affected.note: codewhale (npm) and codewhale-tui (crates.io) <=0.8.67 are affected; fixed in 0.9.0.
The reviewed task_create advisory lists deepseek-tui <0.8.26. This is distinct from the later CodeWhale flaws fixed in 0.9.0.

exposure: The shell issue affects the interactive Agent profile even without YOLO. The automation issue follows an approved automation_create call when the caller omits auto_approve. The earlier task_create issue requires approval of task creation and a sub-agent processing attacker-controlled project instructions; shell execution then proceeds without a separate approval.

params.instructions: Check the installed package name and version. deepseek-tui before 0.8.26 has the task_create default issue; codewhale and codewhale-tui through 0.8.67 have the later shell and automation issues. Review task and automation approval settings.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Upgrade deepseek-tui to 0.8.26 or later for the earlier task_create flaw. Users of codewhale or codewhale-tui should install 0.9.0 or later, which includes the task-path hardening and fixes the later shell and automation flaws.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed component uses the patched release and test the affected workflow with harmless inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.

Added the earlier task_create insecure-default flaw and its distinct deepseek-tui affected range and fix after reading its reviewed advisory. Re-read the existing shell and automation advisories; retained their 0.9.0 remediation and the publication date.
